prompt: My wife left me,  I have never been single since I was living with my parents.   What do I do now?  Where can I turn too? (I am not mentally ill in any way)
response: Being single again after a long time can be tough, but you'll get through it. Try to focus on work or hobbies to keep your mind occupied. You might want to consider therapy to help you adjust, even if you're not mentally ill. It's a good way to talk through your feelings with a professional.
